title: Prove the moment range condition automatically
statement: For homogeneous quartic originalJ and compatible mean-zeroG,the symmetric polarization identity gives Z:H Z=integralD²J(G)[Z,Z]=integralD²J(Z)[G,G]. The last form is CONSTANT inG; Fourier gradients and Legendre-Hadamard positivity atZ proveH>=0. IfZ inkerH,each nonnegative acoustic Fourier contribution vanishes. Compatible finite Fejer approximations G_N preserve those nullspaces and converge strongly inL4. Accepted local quasiconvexity at backgroundZ for BOTH signs of smallt yields0<=t³ b_(G_N):Z+t^4 c_(G_N),forcingb_(G_N):Z=0. StrongL4 convergence givesb:Z=0,henceb inrangeH. Thus only the SHARP inequality b^TH^dagger b<=2c remains in the exact all-mean criterion. No range failure can produce a counterexample under these premises,and the constant2 is not established by this deduction. Variable-Hessian rank-one convexity alone is not used as a false average-Hessian argument.
